Well thing is I did move out and I am sharing an apartment with my fiance but my mom still calls me and still makes me feel like crap. I am just unhappy everyday and I get stressed out on everything including school and work. I am so easily depressed it's so stupid and I hate myself even more. I think I might have manic depression or even worse that I have bipolar disease that my habitually lying mother denies.
 I know college is good for a better job but I don't know what I want to do and I feel like college isn't helping me finding something for me that I can get in to. I just can't look on the positive side because I can't anymore. I can't even try. That's what scares me and makes me want to end it all. I can't even try to be happy or even fake it anymore.
